html: † מִשְׁבְּצ(וֹ)ת n.f. Ex 28:25 pl. chequered (or plaited) work, usually of settings for gems;—מ׳ זָהָב (i.e. plaited with gold-thread) for two gems on high priest’s ephod (P): Ex 28:11, 13; 39:6, 13, 16; מ׳ abs. 28:13, 14, 25; 39:18; מִמּ׳ ז׳ לְבוּשָׁהּ ψ 45:14 her clothing is of chequer work in wrought with gold; < Krochm Gr CheComm. פְּנִינִים בְּמִשְׁבְּצוֹת ז׳ לְבוּשָׁהּ (v. פְּנִימָה p. 819 supr.) pearls in plaited settings of gold(-thread).
